name: Hino Ayane
source:
An honours type who cares about grades and such other things.
She looks down on others, but is that because she is afraid to think of herself as weak?
She has no friends in her class.
She is the head of the tea ceremony club.
In the tea ceremony club, she seems to get along well with others and even laughs.
Her father is the principal of the school and raised her quite strictly.
Her grades have been at the top of the class since he entered the school.

[Translated from the [url=http://www.ume.gr.jp/product/dz/paradox/paradox.html]the official site[/url]]
